name: uran_lattice_cell
description: One 16px-pitch URAN fuel lattice cell: IRON-IRON-URAN-URAN-IRON-IRON rod, then a QRTZ moderator block holding two 1px coolant gaps around an IRON core pair and two PUMP columns (one pump every second row). Tile at step [16,0].
why: Save 895042 (Uran reactor) builds its whole core (x342-439, 7 rods) from this repeat: QRTZ is the moderator/window, IRON the cladding, the alternating PUMP cells keep the coolant gaps positive so heat is pushed out along the row, and the source's HSWC bank reads core heat through the IRON. The source interrupts the lattice every ~14 rows with a QRTZ separator band holding PRTO/PRTI pockets (y=244-259) -- not included; add portal_pair instances there for per-row heat extraction. Sibling module qrtz_uran_lattice is the 1186972 BWR lattice (8px pitch, BOYL/VACU); this one is the 895042 16px lattice with PUMP columns.
source: save 895042, x342-357 y232-243 (one pitch, rows before the first separator); row pattern mmUUmmQ^Q.mm.Q^Q / mmUUmmQQQ.mm.QQQ
